sentences.en: The mice in a big house were afraid.

words.caphi_raw: y b a y y i t

sentences.en: Of the cat.
The cat comes without a sound.
And catches one.

words.caphi_raw: y i t m a s s a k

sentences.en: Every day.
And the mice never know when.
So they held a meeting.

words.caphi_raw: 2 i j t i m aa 3

sentences.en: One mouse said: we must do something.
Another said: we leave the house.

words.caphi_raw: h a r r i b

sentences.en: They said: no.
The house has food.
A third said: we fight the cat.
They said: no.
The cat is stronger.
And fell silent.

words.caphi_raw: s a k k i t

sentences.en: And a young mouse got up.
And said: I have an idea.
The problem is that she comes without a sound.

words.caphi_raw: m u sh k i l e

sentences.en: So we put a bell on her neck.

words.caphi_raw: r a Q a b e

sentences.en: And when she moves, the bell rings.

words.caphi_raw: t 7 a r r a k

sentences.en: And we hear her, and run.

words.caphi_raw: y i h r u b

sentences.en: And the mice clapped.
They said: a great idea!
And an old mouse got up.
And said: a great idea.
But I have a question.
Who is going to put on the bell?
And there was silence.
And every mouse looked at the next.

words.caphi_raw: y i t. t. a l l a 3

sentences.en: And no one answered.
Talking is easy, and doing is hard.
